■ Stage Direction

Personality: Cheerful
1 second silence at start

...Will I ever be able to become like all of you?
As a proud member of the Mejiro family...?

The middle of the race will test who can hold out the longest. Worrying about your time
and breaking pace will only put you at a disadvantage. But when the critical moment comes—

Rumor has it her running isn't that great. They showed up like, "Here are the Mejiro family's
rising stars," but man, I'm kinda worried about her.

Her engine just takes a little time to warm up, but her late burst is magnificent.
If she makes her move at the right moment, she won't lose to anyone.

“Ryan has a wonderful stride! She's bound to achieve greatness.
...Hm? Bright? ...For now, just watch from the sidelines.”

The Mejiro family event drew to a close amid great excitement.
On the way home, as Mejiro Bright and I basked in the lingering afterglow—

With more training, she could go even further—with that in mind, I realized
that I found myself wanting to see the scenery ahead... to see the future illuminated by her light.

Ahaha... wow, this is even worse than I thought...
How are you supposed to train a girl who takes two whole minutes for 1800 meters?

Ugh... I-I can't hold out anymore!
It might be early, but... here I go-o-o!!

Here they come on the final straight! All the Umamusume make their—
Wait, what's this?! Mejiro Bright comes storming out from dead last?!

Please, look upon me, everyone...!
I am the new light—that shall illuminate the Mejiro family's glory!

...I must produce results in the Debut Selection, without fail.
I have to deliver a performance that meets everyone's expectations...

And so, Mejiro Bright and I set out on our journey through
the Twinkle Series, reaching toward a new light!

...I saw it. I saw your strength... and your resolve.
I have to... move forward, too...!

The dead leaves I watched over have fallen, but they nurture new life once more.
If one can only endure the long, bitter winter, the season of budding will soon arrive.

I shall deliver wonderful results in tomorrow's selection race.
And then——on to my debut!

——Haaah~. What a lovely time that was.
Seeing everyone look so proud... I want to greet everyone in an official setting soon, too~.

...Big sister~. Do you think I'll be able to... someday...
become like all of you, big sisters?
Yeees♪

...!
I'm so delighted~. Yaaay.

You will! I'm not really sure what "like us" means, though.
If you want to be, Bright, you can do it!

(...It's all right. I will bide my time at my own pace.
And when I know the time to bloom has come...——)

Unless... you show me the way.
Would you please watch over the arrival of spring alongside me?

Interim Trainer~. I am all finished preparing.
So, what are we doing today~?

——Today's event was totally awesome, but honestly,
what's the deal with Bright and Dober? You never hear anything about them.

T-Two minutes...!? For 1,800 meters!?
Th-That's so slow...! Almost ten seconds slower than average...!

The clock was certainly slow. But with this sluggish pace, her closing burst
to solidly overtake at the very end will undoubtedly be a lethal weapon in top-class races!

...Oh? The leaves have... all fallen off, haven't they~?
Even though they were trying so hard to cling on...

From the time I had spent with her so far, I knew she wasn't easily shaken by minor criticism.
However, today seemed to be different——
...Ngh.

The place I aim for lies at a distant summit.
To journey there all alone would be simply too dazzling.

Well then, Trainer~.
I will be in your care once again starting today~.

Fufu.
I shall... most definitely show you a run worthy of your expectations!

Just as we practiced, I bide my time and surge forward all at once... right?
...Will I be able to win?

...W-Wait, ...relaxed is one thing, but...
Someone, move up already... or else...!
As an umamusume of the Mejiro family, I will surely...

Hehe... How fascinating.
Even so, this is far too slow.
Ye~es♪
“Bright!”

“—Bright, huh. That poor girl is just so frail...
Racing is going to be far too difficult for her, I'm afraid.”

...I understand now.
I must have been waiting here... all this time, just for you.
So—let's run together!

Bright, what are you... Ah, I see. You were watching everyone.
You should run with us instead!

(—I can hear your voice.
The time for me to sprout and bloom... is now!!)

...Hey, this might be none of my business, but if you're going to
be Bright's Trainer, you need to be strict when it counts.

...How long do you plan to just watch? If you're going to be Bright's Trainer,
you've got to put your foot down when needed, or you won't get anywhere.

...Oh my! A bud...
I can see a tiny one popping up~!

—And they're off! In this 6-runner 1800-meter turf race,
the pace is settling into a relaxed, leisurely rhythm!

“That” Mejiro Bright is in the field too. Taking it easy as always...
If she misses her moment to make a move, it's over for her. Will she be okay?

And with that, Mejiro Bright claimed a brilliant victory in the selection race!
However—

—My... spring.
Is it... already right around the corner?

Is that so~?
Spring... will be arriving soon, won't it?

Up until now, she had steadily progressed at her own unhurried pace.
It was only because she had that foundation that my advice brought about a change.

—Wait, today's field... is full of runners who prefer to race from behind.
They'll probably hold back until the final stretch, so it's likely to be a slow pace.

Hooray~ Phew~
I am making my debu~t♪

This is... where I first met you...
Fufu... Yes, the two of us stood side by side, looking up at that tree—

I'm back, provisional Trainer~
...I won the race~!
